title: Home Assistant 2026.5+ modernization for Meshtastic integration
goal: Update ha-meshtastic for Home Assistant 2026.5+: serialx serial stack, version pins, quality_scale Bronze tracking, channel_name on text message events, and SerialPortSelector in config flow.

stories.title: Bump HA minimum version and dependencies to 2026.5
acceptanceCriteria: manifest.json uses serialx instead of pyserial-asyncio

stories.title: Migrate serial transport from pyserial to serialx
acceptanceCriteria: No direct import of serial or serial_asyncio in serial.py
Disconnect path closes writer without pyserial-specific transport casts

stories.title: channel_name on text message API events
acceptanceCriteria: _on_text_message includes channel_name when packet is on a channel
channel_name resolved from connected_node_channels with LongFast fallback
Unit test asserts channel_name in fired event payload

stories.title: Config flow uses HA 2026 SerialPortSelector
acceptanceCriteria: Manual serial setup uses SerialPortSelector instead of plain cv.string

stories.title: quality_scale.yaml and verification
acceptanceCriteria: quality_scale.yaml exists with Bronze rules tracked
ruff check on changed Python files passes
